name: Abyss Blade
description: The first time you are Drained each turn, gain [E] and draw a card.
flavor: Void Refund.

name: Bird-Faced Vase
description: The first 4 times you play a Power card each combat, heal 3 HP.
flavor: This urn shows the crow god Mazaleth looking mischievous.

name: Cawing Cask
description: Whenever you use a potion, gain 1 Ritual.
flavor: A ceremonially carved barrel depicting the crow god Mazaleth, its contents smell questionable...

name: Final Rites
description: The first time you activate 3 Chant effects in a combat, gain 1 Ritual.
flavor: I leave everything I own to my cat, Noodles. Goodbye, cruel world. XOXO Jouster

name: Zetsumei
description: Every time you play 4 Spells in a combat, gain a Ceremony.
flavor: A blade favored by mages due to its ability to channel casted magic back into itself.

name: Corvid Spirit
description: At the end of your turn, deal 4 damage to the lowest HP enemy, increased by Strength.
flavor: This spectre closely follows behind the damned and cursed.

name: Eye of the Occult
description: Thunderbolt and Darkleech target ALL enemies.
flavor: This gruesome carving imparts magical knowledge to its owner.

name: Manabomb
description: Whenever an enemy dies, transfer any Manaburn it has to a random enemy.

name: Alethea
description: If you do not play any Powers during your turn, draw an additional card next turn.
flavor: From the Abyss.

name: Crescent Talisman
description: Upon pickup, choose a card that does NOT have Conjure, and add Conjure to it.
flavor: “Please, just... don't forget me. Even after I die.”

name: Dessicated Hand
description: Whenever you play a Power card that ISN'T Ceremony, a random card in your hand costs 0 that turn.
flavor: It demands true power, resisting your occultic magicks.

name: Ripped Doll
description: At the start of the first 2 turns of combat, Conjure.
flavor: The last reminder of your prior self. It still holds latent magicks.

name: Gilded Bone Shard
description: Start each combat with 3 Strength. After losing any type of HP, lose that Strength for the rest of combat.
flavor: ...No, not that kind of focus.

name: Shredded Doll
description:
Replaces Ripped Doll.
At the start of your turn, Conjure.
The first time you refresh your Spells each combat, gain 1 Ritual.
flavor: A reminder of your weakness, and yet you still can't let go.

name: Paper Crow
description: Enemies take 25% additional damage from Manaburn.
flavor: Arbiter of doubt and curses folded one thousand times...

name: Tome of Portalmancy
description: Whenever you create a Void, apply 2 Manaburn to ALL enemies.
flavor: A grimoire detailing the construction and maintenance of interplanar gates.

name: Violet Plumage
description: The first time you end your turn with excess [E] each combat, draw 3 additional cards at the start of your next turn.
flavor: Tinged by the unending darkness of oblivion.

name: White Ribbon
description: Whenever you play a card with a Chant effect, gain 4 Block, even if it is not active.
flavor: Gives power to spoken words even without proper ritual.

name: Zener Deck
description: At the start of combat, add ESP to your Spellbook and Conjure it.
flavor: “One, two, three, all eyes should be on me.”

name: Paradox Artifact
description: At the start of each turn, add a random card with Encode to your hand and give it Ethereal.
flavor: You've never seen a coding frenzy like this before.

name: Bottled Code
description: Upon pickup, choose a card with Encode. Start each combat with this card Encoded.
flavor: Actually, I have code for that exact thing...

name: Bronze Core
description: The first time you create a Function each combat, gain [E].
flavor: Replace once every 50,000 years.

name: Bronze Idol
description: Status cards may now be played for useful effects.
flavor: An ancient, weaponised antivirus - who knows who made it, and why?

name: Cable Spool
description: Encode a copy of the first Encodable card you play each combat.
flavor: Tangled...

name: Deca's Washers
description: At the start of the first 3 turns of each combat, draw an additional card.
flavor: It is unclear why Deca collects these.

name: Donu's Washers
description: At the start of combat, gain [E] [E] and add 1 Void into your draw pile.
flavor: It is rather clear why Donu collects these.

name: Electromagnetic Coil
description: Functions are now made up of 4 cards.
flavor: An inefficient but entertaining power source.

name: Makeshift Battery
description: Gain [E] and add a Slimed into your discard pile at the start of your turn.
flavor: It's an 8.9 volt.

name: Mallet
description: At the start of each combat, add 2 copies of Fine Tuning+ to your hand.
flavor: That's it! I'm gettin me mallet!

name: Platinum Core
description:
Replaces Bronze Core.
The first 3 Functions you create each combat cost 0 until played.
flavor: Changelog: Improved user experience.

name: Protective Goggles
description: If you end your turn with no Encoded cards, gain 4 Block.
flavor: Look closely.

name: Silver Bullet
description: At the start of each combat, add a copy of Piercing Shot to your hand. It costs 0.
flavor: Spirewolves are long gone.

name: Frost Primer
description: All Functions you create gain Retain.
flavor: 22 ounces of the chemical compound Ar22, shelf life: 22 years. Best stored in a mahogany fridge.

name: Barbell
description: Whenever you enter a Rest Site, if you have at least 10 Upgradable cards in your deck, Upgrade one at random.
flavor: 1000 reps? Psh. I can do 1001.

name: Berserker's Guide
description: At the start of your turn, gain 3 Vigor.
flavor: The text is illegible.

name: Black Knight's Helm
description:
The first time you enter each Stance each combat:
Defensive: Gain 2 Dexterity and lose 1 Strength.
Berserker: Gain 2 Strength and lose 1 Dexterity.
flavor: Only a flesh wound.

name: Champion's Crown
description: Once per combat, you may enter a Stance you are not in.
flavor: A WINNER IS YOU!

name: Victorious Crown
description:
Replaces Champion's Crown.
The first time you play a Finisher each turn, draw 2 cards and enter a random Stance.
flavor: Conglaturation!! You are the greatest winner.

name: New Challenger
description: Start each combat in a random Champ Stance.
flavor: Can you take the crown?

name: Defensive Thesis
description: Defensive Stance's Finisher Bonus grants 3 more Block.
flavor: Pro tip: Don't get hit.

name: Deflecting Bracers
description: At the start of your turn, gain Counter equal to half the amount of expired Block.
flavor: If you thought blocking was good then...

name: Dueling Glove
description: After using a single-target Attack, if the target has no Vulnerable, apply 1 Vulnerable.
flavor: Count from ten...

name: Dolphin's Style Guide
description: If you end your turn while in no Stance, draw 1 additional card next turn.
flavor: Author: Renowned explorer and pugilist Dolphin K. Mist.

name: Gladiators Manual
description: Whenever you play a Combo, a Finisher, and enter a Stance in the same turn, gain 1 Strength and Dexterity.
flavor: Try everything - something will stick.

name: Inner Strength
description: Start each combat with 1 Strength.
flavor: It's about the gigantic sword in your heart.

name: Power Armor
description:
Gain [E] at the start of your turn.
Your maximum Vigor and Counter is 10.
flavor: Bought used.

name: Amulet of Unyielding
description: Whenever you spend Vigor, gain 1 Strength for every 8 Vigor spent.
flavor: Strength once thought fleeting flows through you as if it had always been there.

name: Signature Finisher
description: Upon pickup, choose a Finisher. This Finisher costs 0, can be used without a Stance, and never causes your Stance to be exited.
flavor: And now, it's time for my ULTIMATE MOVE!

name: Spectre's Hand
description: Whenever you enter a Stance, gain an Echo of a basic Strike or Defend. It costs 0.
flavor: Some victories stay with you.

name: Hexx Talisman
description: At the start of combat, apply 1 Weak and Vulnerable to a random enemy.
flavor: "When I put this on, my rate of toe-stubbing increased drastically. I think it works!" - Ranwid

name: Bag of Tricks
description: At the start of each combat, draw 2 Collected cards.
flavor: Tricky.

name: The Bagpipes
description: Whenever you apply new Weak or Vulnerable to an enemy, increase the amount applied by 1.
flavor: This dreaded instrument is said to have driven Kublai the Great mad.

name: Blocked Chakra
description: Gain [E] at the start of your turn. You don't draw from your Collected pile until your 4th turn.
flavor: One pulled muscle is all it takes.

name: Bottled Brain
description: Upon pickup, Upgrade a card in your Collection. Start combats with it on top of your Collected pile.
flavor: Collected from a wizard's laboratory.

name: Emerald Torch
description: Start each combat with 1 Reserve.
flavor: The fires of greed never fade.

name: Forbidden Fruit
description: Upon pickup, add a Parasite to your deck and gain 10 Max HP. Start each combat with 1 Dexterity.
flavor: This species of fruit looks completely unfamiliar.

name: Fuel Canister
description: At the end of your turn, Retain the lowest-cost card in your hand.
flavor: Disgusting.

name: Krampian Coal
description: When you would draw from an empty Collected pile, add a Lucky Wick to your hand.
flavor: "Intriguing! But why only specific chimneys?" - Ranwid

name: Incense
description: You cannot gain Weak, Vulnerable or Frail while you are Weak, Vulnerable or Frail.
flavor: An antiquated form of mental clarification.

name: Jade Ring
description: Enemies take 6 more damage from Doom.
flavor: Jade is the symbol of honesty.

name: Prismatic Torch
description: Replaces Emerald Torch. At the start of each combat, add an Ember into your hand and gain 1 Reserve. The first time you Exhaust an Ember each turn, gain 1 Reserve.
flavor: The ever-changing flames reflect fortune's favor.

name: Soul-lit Lamp
description: Upon pickup, gain 3 Essence. At the start of combat, add an Ember into your hand.
flavor: A ghoulish decoration. The crackles of fire are replaced by buzzing wails.

name: The Contract
description: Upon pickup, gain 10 Essence.
flavor: Sign in blood.

name: Thimble Helm
description: Start each combat with 3 Temporary HP. While you have Temporary HP, cards grant 1 additional Block.
flavor: Worn by the Spire's miniest heroes.

name: Fragmentation Grenade
description: Damage dealt to random enemies is increased by 3.
flavor: Nobody dares to ask where the Gremlin got it from.

name: Gremlin Bomb
description: Whenever a Gremlin dies, deal 30 damage to ALL enemies.
flavor: Gremlins have an uncanny knack for finding dangerous things. Sometimes, they even survive looting them.

name: Gremlin Gravestone
description: Dead Gremlins can be Resurrected at Rest Sites as a Free Action.
flavor: Where do gremlins go when they die? Not bloody far enough.

name: Mob Leader's Staff
description: At the start of each combat, gain [E], draw 1 card, and Swap to the next Gremlin.
flavor: Among gremlin mobs, the one with the best horn maintains complete command over the troupe, until another one manages to steal it.

name: Mob Leader's Crown
description:
Replaces Mob Leader's Staff.
The first time you shuffle your draw pile each turn, gain [E], draw 1 card, and Swap to the next Gremlin.
flavor: The fancier the symbol of office, the more likely it is to be stolen.

name: Impeccable Pecs
description:
Whenever you gain Strength, gain an equal amount of Temporary HP.
Start each combat with 1 Strength.
flavor: Glorious.

name: Gremlin Leader's Voucher
description:
Gain [E] at the start of your turn.
Upon pickup, permanently lose a Gremlin.
flavor: IOU 1 Gremlin

name: Magic Mallet
description: Whenever you apply Weak, gain 1 Wiz, up to 3 times per turn.
flavor: Stubs toes twice as hard.

name: Prickly Shields
description: Whenever you gain Block, deal 2 damage to a random enemy.
flavor: Gremlins use whatever scraps they can find as weapons or armor. Some serve as both.

name: Short Statue
description: The first time a Gremlin would die each combat, heal it to 75% of your Max HP instead.
flavor: It is surprising how well it works.

name: Stolen Merchandise
description:
Whenever you Swap, gain an Echo of a random Colorless card.
At the start of combat, the Merchant gains 2 Strength.
flavor: "Blasted, thieving Gremlins!".

name: Supply Scroll
description: At the start of your 3rd turn, gain [E] [E] and draw 2 cards.
flavor: A surprisingly detailed inventory of the mob's various bits and bobbles.

name: Tag Teamwork
description:
Whenever you draw Tag Team, draw another card.
Upon pickup, add two copies of Tag Team to your deck.
flavor: Teamwork makes the dream work.

name: Wizard Hat
description: Whenever you consume Wiz, remove a debuff at random.
flavor: The accompanying robes have long since been stolen.

name: Wizard Staff
description: Wiz deals 7 additional damage.
flavor: The pride and joy of every Gremlin Wizard, this staff is a frequent target of theft by rival mobs.

name: Wound Poker
description: At the end of each turn, deal 4 damage to each Weakened enemy.
flavor: Does it hurt when I do this?

name: Bottled Anomaly
description: Upon pickup, choose a card. At the start of each combat, remove it from your draw pile. At the start of turn 3, add it into your hand. It costs 0 for the turn.
flavor: Swirling and swirling and finally breaking.

name: Bottled Black Hole
description: Upon pickup, choose a card. Start each combat with this card in Stasis.
flavor: Somewhere, something incredible is waiting to be known.

name: Baalor's Lordly Plate
description: Whenever you Brace, Brace 1 more.
flavor: One can never have enough armor.

name: Gemstone Gun
description: Upon pickup, choose 3 Gems. At the start of each combat, gain a card with Retain, Exhaust, and each chosen Gem socketed.
flavor: Bang! Bang! Bang! Hey, I matched three!

name: Bronze Gear
description:
At the start of each combat, gain Gear Up.
Guardian starts the run with a random common Gem.
flavor: Protection where you need it most.

name: Guardian Gear
description:
Replaces Bronze Gear.
At the start of combat, gain Gear Up.
Whenever you enter Defensive Mode, gain [E] and draw 2 cards.
flavor: Replace every 3,000 floors.

name: Obsidian Scales
description: At the start of combat, gain 3 Thorns. Whenever you are debuffed or gain a debuff, gain 1 Thorns.
flavor: Stain the sky black with your blood. Retaliate against all who struck out at you.

name: Pick of Rhapsody
description: Whenever you defeat an Elite encounter, add a random Gem to the rewards.
flavor: With as many gemstones that litter the Spire, it is hard to imagine anyone so unlucky to have needed this Pick to aid them.

name: Arumba's Pocket Sentry
description: Every 3 turns, apply 1 Weak to ALL enemies.
flavor: Sentry Mode active. Target acquired. No hard feelings.

name: Sack of Gems
description: Upon pickup, you may choose up to 5 random Gems to add to your deck.
flavor: Ooh... shiny!

name: Pilot's Codex
description: At the end of your first 3 turns, if your Stasis slots aren't full, choose 1 of 3 cards to place into Stasis.
flavor: Designs and diagrams of the Spire's earliest manually-driven prototypes, by Master Pilot David.

name: Quantum Chamber
description: Upon pickup, choose a card. Start each combat with this card removed from your deck. At the start of your 4th turn, return it and 2 copies of it to your hand.
flavor: You get the chicken by hatching the egg, not by smashing it.

name: Wander Bots
description:
At the start of each combat, lose 1 Stasis slot.
Gain [E] at the start of your turn.
flavor: These drones find the most wonderful salvage, but require processing power to maintain.

name: Cryo Chamber
description: At the start of each combat, gain 1 Stasis slot. Whenever a card enters Stasis, Upgrade it.
flavor: Things always seem better coming out than they did going in.

name: Shotglass
description: First 2 times you use a potion each combat, gain a random potion. You can only use 2 potions each combat.
flavor: Any liquid placed inside changes into something else.

name: Black Powder
description: Whenever you trigger a Dead On effect, deal 2 damage to ALL enemies.
flavor: Handle with care.

name: Broken Tooth
description: Whenever you defeat an Elite encounter, heal 7 HP and gain 35 Gold.
flavor: Appears too large to have come from a human jaw...

name: Brass Tacks
description: At the end of your turn, gain 2 Block.
flavor: The luster on these tacks never seems to fade.

name: Charred Glove
description: Whenever you draw a Curse, your next attack deals 3 more damage.
flavor: Parts of the glove still glow with otherworldly cinders.

name: Clasped Locket
description: Replaces Old Locket. First time you draw a Curse each turn, Exhaust it and draw 2 cards. Upon pickup, obtain 2 Injuries.
flavor: It won't open anymore.

name: Dented Plate
description: While your HP is at or below 50%, gain [E] and draw 1 card at the start of your turn.
flavor: Several bullets are still lodged inside.

name: Horseshoe
description: Whenever you gain Weak, Frail or Vulnerable, gain 1 less.
flavor: Lucky charm. Somebody is gonna be missing this.

name: Old Locket
description: At the start of each combat, add a Memento into your hand.
flavor: There's a faded picture inside.

name: Pet Ghost
description: Prevent your first lethal HP loss each combat.
flavor: Poor guy.

name: Red Scarf
description: Whenever you apply a new debuff to an enemy, gain 3 Block.
flavor: It's warm and fuzzy.

name: Rye Stalk
description: Whenever you lose HP during enemy turn, draw 1 card.
flavor: Still in mint condition, despite being chewed on for so long.

name: Spyglass
description: If you end your turn Concentrated, gain an additional [E] next turn.
flavor: Property of Kestin Highfin.

name: Straight Razor
description: Whenever you remove or Transform a card from your deck, heal 15 HP.
flavor: For a cleaner shave...

name: Tricky's Bolster-Rod
description: The first time you play a Power each combat, gain 4 Block and 1 Strength.
flavor: Backed by the study of a thousand books. Knowledge is power!

name: Red Candle
description: Whenever you apply Soulburn, apply 2 additional Soulburn.
flavor: Fire BURNS...

name: Xanatos' Icy Charm
description: Gain [E] at the start of your turn. Start each combat with 1 less Intensity, and receive no Intensity from the Inferno Ghostflame.
flavor: I feel... cold.

name: Jar of TOBSCo
description: Start each combat with 1 Intensity.
flavor: A little extra heat makes everything better.

name: Olexa's Shield
description: Powers are counted towards the progression of Searing and Crushing Ghostflames.
flavor: Protection on-demand.

name: Libra
description: Transform your Strikes into random Skills, and your Defends into random Attacks.
flavor: Balance in all things.

name: Sneaky Teakwood Match
description: The first time you Ignite each turn, you can choose whether to Advance or Retract.
flavor: Lights on any surface!

name: Recycler
description: The first time a non-Status, non-Curse Ethereal card is Exhausted each combat, add a copy to your hand that costs 0 until played.
flavor: One day, it shall be recycled too.

name: Six-Point Brand
description: Whenever you play 6 non-0 cost cards, gain an Echo of a basic Strike. It costs 0.
flavor: Fire, fire, fire, fire, fire, FIRE!

name: Soul of Chaos
description: At the start of your turn, move to a random Ghostflame and randomize it. At the end of your turn, play the top card of your draw pile.
flavor: Mayhem, made manifest.

name: Soul Stone
description: Whenever you Exhaust 4 cards, Ignite the current Ghostflame.
flavor: A soul would liven this thing up!

name: Spirit Brand
description: The first time you Ignite a Ghostflame each turn, gain 4 Block.
flavor: A bound protector.

name: Mark of the Ether
description:
Replaces Spirit Brand.
Whenever you Ignite a Ghostflame, gain 4 Block.
flavor: Let's see if we can do... better.

name: Heart of Goo
description: Whenever you Consume, heal 2 HP, up to 8 each combat.
flavor: I feel so funky.

name: Black Heart of Goo
description:
Replaces Heart of Goo.
Whenever you Consume, heal 3 HP, up to 15 each combat.
flavor: The Secret of the Ooze.

name: Goop Dweller
description: At the start of combat, Split into a Bruiser Slime.
flavor: He followed me home. Can I keep it?

name: Greed Ooze
description:
At the start of combat, spawn Greed Ooze (can be revived if Absorbed).
At Rest Sites, Greed Ooze will take 50 of your souls, increasing its damage by 1.
flavor: A friend found in the Spire who devours souls.

name: Jeremiah's Banner
description: At the start of combat, gain 1 Slime slot and Split into a random Slime.
flavor: You and ooze army.

name: Stone of Nomakk
description: At the start of combat, gain 1 Potency.
flavor: When presented to one of your Goop Gang, it seems to make the blob dance.

name: Slime Soup
description: When you enter a Rest Site, begin the next combat with a Prepare card that costs 0.
flavor: Tastes awful, but incredibly healthy.

name: Scrap Ooze
description:
At the start of combat, spawn Scrap Ooze (can be revived if Absorbed).
At Rest Sites, you can donate a card to the Scrap Ooze, modifying its damage:
+1 damage for Uncommons
+2 damage for Rares
-1 damage for Commons
-2 damage for Curses

name: Protective Gear
description: Reduce the damage you take from Tackles by 3.
flavor: The best defense is a good offense.

name: Slimy Skull
description: Whenever you apply Goop, apply an additional 1 Goop.
flavor: A Snecko skull in absolutely awful condition. Unclean and slimy, dirt and grime stick to it like glue.

name: Slimed Tail
description: Whenever you Split, gain 3 Block.
flavor: A fake tail to trick enemies during combat, completely covered in slime.

name: Gelatinous Cube
description: Whenever you draw a Status or Curse, gain 3 Block.
flavor: Hey, it stuck to your body.

name: Tarr Blob
description: Gain [E] at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, lose 1 Slime slot.
flavor: The bad kind of Slime.

name: Young Snecko
description: Deals 9 damage to a random enemy and Muddles 2 random (at least 1 cost) cards in your hand at the start of your turn.
flavor: Bewilderingly adorable.

name: Blank Card
description: At the start of each combat, add an Echo of a random non-Curse, non-Status card from your deck to your hand. It costs 0.
flavor: Card Mimic.

name: Snake-Charmer's Flute
description: Muddled cards can't cost 3.
flavor: Sssssss...

name: Ring of the Snek
description: Whenever you activate 3 Overflow effects, apply 1 Weak and Vulnerable to a random enemy.
flavor: Illegible, unreadable, due by Thursday.

name: Mystical Octahedron
description: Upon pickup, choose a card that has an Overflow effect. Whenever you play it, gain 4 Block and activate its Overflow effect, even if you don't have more than 5 cards in hand.
flavor: It appears weighted toward one side.

name: Loaded Die
description: Whenever a card is Muddled, gain 1 Block.
flavor: Cheese-stuffed.

name: Rare Booster Box
description: Upon pickup, obtain an Offclass Rare card.
flavor: Mint condition.

name: Sleeved Ace
description: At the start of each combat, gain a Marked Card+.
flavor: We're all aces.

name: Lucky Horseshoe
description: Upon pickup, obtain 3 Upgraded Uncommon and 2 Rare cards. All combats drop an additional card reward.
flavor: Make your own luck.

name: Seal of Approval
description: Upon pickup, choose 1 of 5 Uncommon Offclass Powers to obtain.
flavor: I'm The Ironclad and this is my favorite Relic in the Spire. -Merchant Advertising Pamphlet

name: Snecko Soul
description: At the start of each combat, add Soul Roll to your hand.

name: Idol of Retromation
description: At the start of your turn, reduce the cost of a random card in your hand by 1 until played.
flavor: Often called the Idol of Reto for short.

name: Super Snecko Soul
description:
Replaces Snecko Soul.
At the start of each combat and every other turn, gain a Soul Roll.
On other turns, draws an additional card at the start of your turn and Muddles it.

name: Unidentified Egg
description: Whenever you add an Offclass card to your deck, Upgrade it. Upon pickup, Upgrade 2 random Offclass cards.
flavor: What will hatch? Pay $1000 to see.
